slides.h1: 5 mistakes that make building in public not work.

slides.lead: Setbacks are the posts people remember. Wins without context feel like ads.
Devs are great company. But if your users aren't devs, some posts should speak to them.
Trust is the whole point. One inflated stat undoes months of posts.
It works through consistency. Schedule ahead so busy weeks don't break the streak.
Ask a question. Ask them to try it. An audience that's never asked never acts.
